title: Bar Drop Mr Blue 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Mr Blue by Drop is a classic berry blend with a complex, mysterious profile. It features a rich medley of dark fruits, combining the deep, juicy taste of blackcurrant, the sweet tang of blueberry, and the sharp kick of raspberry. This trio creates a layered and intense berry experience that is well-rounded and deeply satisfying. This e-liquid is mixed with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, a specification chosen to ensure the intricate mix of berry notes is delivered with absolute clarity. Ideally suited for low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, the nicotine salt base ensures a smooth and comfortable draw, available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
